newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher following Dow's surge.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher following Dow's surge.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rallied in early morning trade on Wednesday, following the Dow industrials' overnight advance by the second-largest amount ever.
Financial issues, which had plunged earlier this year, continued their recovery.
The 225-share Nikkei average climbed 218.93 points or 1.18 percent to 18,763.38 in the first 10 minutes of trade. Its June futures jumped 230 points to 18,780.
Before closing slightly lower on Tuesday, the Nikkei 225 index had posted gains for five consecutive sessions.
